verdicts.reason: Documentation is extensive but nowhere states the site's job in one sentence. STRATEGY.md and README.md state the framework/plugin's purpose (a paragraph, not the page's job); docs/frames/ holds only a README (no frame was written for the site); the page was 'extracted verbatim' from another repo (commit 18ffcf2) and later 'updated ... Visual baseline untouched; no redesign' (commit c61b896). The closest thing is the page's own <meta> description in src/app/page.tsx and the v0.2 critique line 'POC evidence UI — the demo shows version, construction and evidence separately', which describes a v0.2 feature of the page, not the v0.3 site's job.
verdicts.quote: A design engineer working through AI agents produces more interface than they can carefully judge, and the judgment they do apply disappears when the session ends.

verdicts.reason: STRATEGY.md states the bet (knowledge should compound; an artifact must be earned; a claim may never exceed its evidence) and compound-design/docs/V0.2-DESIGN-CRITIQUE.md explicitly weighs 'Direction B — polish only (improve the public narrative and visual presentation)' against 'Direction C — evidence architecture', rejects B as insufficient, and derives the page decision 'POC evidence UI — the demo shows version, construction and evidence separately' from the chosen bet. Commit c61b896 carries the same logic into the v0.3 site: 'Site updated to the six-stage loop, the v0.3 resource set with a dash where construction is unaudited'.
verdicts.quote:
### Direction B — polish only
Improve the public narrative and visual presentation. ... Decision: useful but insufficient. ... 5. **POC evidence UI** — the demo shows version, construction and evidence separately.

verdicts.reason: No document records stack/time/team/design-system constraints for the site before it was built. docs/frames and docs/plans contain only READMEs. The only constraint records are in the commit bodies of the commits that did the work (18ffcf2: 'Standalone package.json: next, react, react-dom, geist only ... layout.tsx and globals.css reduced to the document baseline the page needs (Geist Sans/Mono, dark ground) ... Static export config'; c61b896: 'Visual baseline untouched; no redesign'), i.e. recorded at build time, not before; time and team constraints are never recorded. NOTICE and package.json describe the stack after the fact.
verdicts.quote: The public page implementation (`src/app/page.tsx`, `page.module.css`) was extracted from the author's `studio-dev-ui` repository. No other part of that application is carried here.

verdicts.reason: Decision rationale is recorded in several places: compound-design/docs/V0.2-DESIGN-CRITIQUE.md (divergence/convergence with pros, risks and a decision per direction), compound-design/research/EVERY-ARCHITECTURE-SNAPSHOT.md (adopt/adapt/defer/reject with reasons, per commit 7c31d66), compound-design/learning/LEDGER.md (observed/expected/human_correction/lesson entries), the release record compound-design/releases/v0.3.0-alpha.1-WORK-SYSTEM.md, and commit bodies that explain why (e.g. 6aea1fd: 'actions/checkout defaults to a depth-1 clone, which does not contain that commit, so the gate could only ever pass locally'; 592cb34: 'a guard that cannot distinguish stating a rule from breaking it blocks the rule ... recorded as CD-20260909-012').
verdicts.quote: ### Direction A — expand the catalog ... Risks: duplicated responsibilities; weaker routing; more maintenance; sophistication without proof. Decision: reject for v0.2.
